title: [GMCP 203.021.03] Integration: Local MCP gateway, reverse proxy, and aggregation plane
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-021-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: GMCP exposes many local or remote servers as one policy-enforced endpoint while preserving original server identity, capabilities, schemas, errors, progress, cancellation, subscriptions and trace context. Routing and transformation are deterministic; backpressure, quotas and failure isolation prevent one backend from harming others; and direct-versus-gateway differential tests prove no semantic loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
